# Awesome Social Media Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A curated list of agent skills for social media: X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn, plus China's Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin, WeChat and Bilibili. From ideas and drafts to images, publishing and analytics. Install them into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen, Doubao or WorkBuddy.

This list collects social media skills for AI agents: writing posts and threads, making covers and short videos, scheduling, tracking trends, replying to comments and reading analytics. Most use the standard SKILL.md format, so any agent that supports skills can install them; see the [FAQ](#faq). Every project was checked by hand and scanned by a script before it was listed, and is sorted by job and platform.

Many projects come from China's creator scene (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat Official Accounts) and are documented in Chinese; the descriptions below are translated.

353 skill projects + 51 MCP tools and open-source platforms · metadata updated 2026-11-16

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🔌 MCP server or CLI tool · 🧩 full app · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

**Let your agent choose**: this list is also a skill. Run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-social-media-skills` to install social-media-skill-finder, then ask your agent "I run a LinkedIn account for my startup. Which skill should I use to write posts?"

> [!WARNING]
> Tools that post or reply for you usually log in as you, and some keep your cookies on disk. Read the SKILL.md and scripts before installing to see where your session is stored and where it is sent. Platforms limit automation; bulk posting can get an account throttled or banned.

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. The script scan looks for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files, and lists the network addresses in scripts. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe.

<a id="group-writing"></a>
### Writing and content

Write posts, threads, titles, voice-over scripts and long articles, adapt them to each platform's voice, make them read less like AI, and check for banned words and reach risks before posting.

- 🌟 **[humanizer](https://github.com/blader/humanizer)** · ★ 69.5k<br>Makes AI-written English sound like a person wrote it without changing what it says, built on Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing guide.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-10 · English · MIT</sub>

- 🌟 **[Humanizer-zh](https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh)** · ★ 22.9k<br>Chinese humanizer: edits out empty phrases, repetition and templated wording while keeping facts, certainty and the author's voice; sentences without problems are left alone.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-23 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[khazix-skills](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/khazix-skills)** · ★ 22.3k<br>Skills from Khazix (数字生命卡兹克). For writing, khazix-writer drafts WeChat long-form articles in his voice and rhythm, 4,000–8,000 characters by default, then self-checks facts, style and pacing; aihot pulls the daily AI news.<br><sub>Platforms: WeChat OA</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-15 · Chinese · 6 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[lieflat-less-ai-tone](https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone)** · ★ 7.7k<br>Chinese AI-tone removal built on a 5.2-million-character human vs AI corpus study: it first delivers a detection report with metrics, example sentences and fixes, then makes minimal rewrites and re-tests only after you approve.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-11 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 CC BY-NC 4.0: no commercial use.</sub>

- **[human-writing](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/human-writing)** · ★ 4.6k<br>Chinese writing that sounds like a specific person: Zhihu answers, WeChat articles, reviews, voice-over scripts and more. Gathers enough material before writing.<br><sub>Platforms: WeChat OA · Zhihu</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-15 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[writing-dna-skill](https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/writing-dna-skill)** · ★ 3.2k<br>Writing DNA distiller: learns an account's or author's language, structure, topic logic and sourcing from at least 20 articles, then writes in that style.<br><sub>Platforms: Newsletter · RedNote · WeChat OA · Weibo</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-11 · Chinese · 2 skills</sub>

- **[shuorenhua](https://github.com/MrGeDiao/shuorenhua)** · ★ 2.6k<br>Shuorenhua: Chinese-first AI-tone rewrite that cuts stock phrases and repeated preamble while keeping numbers, conditions, commitments and the author's voice, so the result is ready to post.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-15 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[ai-copywriter](https://github.com/mikiarlo3/ai-copywriter)** · ★ 1.2k<br>Copy that earns attention and reads human: titles, short descriptions, microcopy and subject lines, with LinkedIn's short-paragraph rhythm built in.<br><sub>Platforms: LinkedIn</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-01 · English · MIT</sub>

- **[Viral_Writer_Skill](https://github.com/nashsu/Viral_Writer_Skill)** · ★ 842<br>Give it a topic and get a full article built on 11 content-insight dimensions, five title options and image prompts, written for WeChat, Xiaohongshu or Douyin.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · Douyin · WeChat OA</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-03-24 💤 · Chinese</sub>

- **[yuwen-publish-precheck](https://github.com/yuwen-cool/yuwen-publish-precheck)** · ★ 816<br>Pre-publish review for Douyin, Xiaohongshu and WeChat Channels: flags risky lines in scripts, posts, subtitles and cover text, cites the official rule and suggests a compliant rewrite.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · Douyin · 视频号</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-08 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[qu-ai-wei](https://github.com/LifelongLazyLearner/qu-ai-wei)** · ★ 754<br>Simplified Chinese humanizer: removes stock phrases, translationese and mechanical parallelism while keeping facts, register and the author's voice.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-10 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[anti-ai-slop-writing](https://github.com/jalaalrd/anti-ai-slop-writing)** · ★ 609<br>Produces human-sounding English by avoiding statistically detectable AI writing patterns in tweets, emails, articles, bios and captions.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-04-18 💤 · English</sub>

- **[taishang-laojun](https://github.com/liuhaisi2026212-maker/taishang-laojun)** · ★ 569<br>Talking-head videos for Douyin and Xiaohongshu, from a Douyin creator's method: works out who you are and who you want to reach, breaks down hits, plans topics and series, writes a script you can read on camera; also titles, post-mortems, de-AI edits.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · Douyin</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-08 · Chinese · 8 skills</sub><br><sub>💡 CC BY-NC 4.0: no commercial use.</sub>

- **[gainubi/wechat-skills](https://github.com/gainubi/wechat-skills)** · ★ 173<br>Xiaogai's WeChat writing skills: build a style DNA from 3–10 sample articles, write first drafts in that style, and make flat explanatory illustrations.<br><sub>Platforms: WeChat OA</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-21 · Chinese · 7 skills</sub>

- **[traffic-compass](https://github.com/code-wahaha/traffic-compass)** · ★ 102<br>Pre-publish check for Douyin: flags banned ad-law terms, traffic-diversion words, AI-label and licensing red lines, suggests minimal edits and estimates a view range by follower count and niche.<br><sub>Platforms: Douyin</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-07 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[content-risk-detector](https://github.com/liuxingqitd/content-risk-detector)** · ★ 58<br>Compliance check for short-video transcripts against Douyin, Xiaohongshu and WeChat Channels community rules, with a graded risk report and suggested edits.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · Douyin · 视频号</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-14 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

WeChat article layout, covers, info cards and illustrations; cutting short videos, subtitles and shot lists.

- 🌟 **[gzh-design-skill](https://github.com/isjiamu/gzh-design-skill)** · ★ 4.4k<br>WeChat article layout: turns Markdown into paste-ready HTML for the WeChat editor, with six themes, a theme generator and fully inlined styles that survive pasting.<br><sub>Platforms: WeChat OA</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-21 · Chinese</sub>

- **[guizang-ppt-skill](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-ppt-skill)** · ★ 29.8k<br>Guizang's web slides: turns an article into a single-file HTML deck in an editorial or Swiss style, with speaker mode and rehearsal, and reuses the same look for WeChat 21:9 and 1:1, Xiaohongshu 3:4 and Channels covers.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · WeChat OA · 视频号</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-30 · Chinese · AGPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>💡 Generated images need Codex with GPT-Image; without it you still get layout-only decks.</sub>

- **[ian-xiaohei-illustrations](https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xiaohei-illustrations)** · ★ 13.2k<br>Ian's Xiaohei hand-drawn article illustrations: reads a Chinese article, picks the judgments, flows or metaphors worth drawing, and turns them into 4–8 white-background 16:9 images starring a small black character.<br><sub>Platforms: WeChat OA</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-27 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Written for Codex: images come from Codex's built-in image_gen, so other agents need their own image tool.</sub>

- **[native-subtitle-quote-image](https://github.com/chengyi-ai/native-subtitle-quote-image)** · ★ 2.9k<br>Turns a video into a captioned long image for social posts: from a local file or YouTube link it finds the lines, grabs exact frames, stitches and checks each image, keeping burned-in subtitles or drawing your approved lines, marked as added.<br><sub>Platforms: Any platform</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-06 · Multilingual · MIT</sub>

- **[herk-edit-kit](https://github.com/nateherkai/herk-edit-kit)** · ★ 2.9k<br>Nate Herk's editing kit: transcript-driven cuts of silences and mistakes, story planning, 406 motion-graphics cards and HyperFrames templates for videos, Reels and Shorts.<br><sub>Platforms: YouTube · Instagram</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-14 · English · 15 skills</sub>

- **[youtube-shorts-pipeline](https://github.com/rushindrasinha/youtube-shorts-pipeline)** · ★ 2.4k<br>Vertical video engine with niche intelligence: one topic in, researched script, AI visuals, voiceover, captions and upload out, at about $0.11 per video.<br><sub>Platforms: YouTube · TikTok · Instagram</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-09 · English · MIT</sub>

### Publishing and automation

Get content onto the platforms: scheduling, cross-posting and browser automation. Most of these log in as you, so check how they store your session before installing.

- 🌟 **[social-auto-upload](https://github.com/dreammis/social-auto-upload)** · ★ 16.6k<br>Upload videos to Douyin, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Channels, Bilibili, Kuaishou, Weibo, TikTok, YouTube and more with scheduling, via the sau CLI and four agent skills.<br><sub>Platforms: YouTube · TikTok · RedNote · Douyin · 视频号 · Bilibili · Weibo · Kuaishou</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-22 · Chinese · 18 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[Wechatsync](https://github.com/wechatsync/Wechatsync)** · ★ 6.6k<br>Article sync: cross-post WeChat articles to Zhihu, Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, Juejin, CSDN and 29+ platforms through a Chrome extension that uses your own logins; MCP included.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · WeChat OA · Zhihu · 头条</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-15 · Chinese · GPL-3.0</sub>

- **[XiaohongshuSkills](https://github.com/white0dew/XiaohongshuSkills)** · ★ 3.6k<br>Xiaohongshu auto-publishing, commenting and search via Chrome DevTools Protocol: image and video posts, multiple accounts, headless mode.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-15 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[autoclaw-cc/xiaohongshu-skills](https://github.com/autoclaw-cc/xiaohongshu-skills)** · ★ 2k<br>Xiaohongshu automation using your logged-in browser and real account: login, image and video posts, search, comments and likes, ready to use.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-23 · Chinese · 6 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[MatrixMedia](https://github.com/hanliang97/MatrixMedia)** · ★ 1.4k<br>MatrixMedia: batch-publish videos to Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Baijiahao, Toutiao and Fanqie, and check login status and publish history.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote · Douyin · 视频号 · Bilibili · Kuaishou · 头条</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-14 · Chinese · 4 skills · GPL-2.0</sub><br><sub>💡 The skills drive the MatrixMedia desktop app, which you install first.</sub>

<a id="group-strategy"></a>

Find a niche and persona, plan content, and grow and monetize an account.

<a id="group-mcp"></a>
### MCP servers and CLI tools (not skills)

Tools that let an agent read from and post to a platform; often paired with the skills above. Not counted as skills.

- 🌟 **[xiaohongshu-mcp](https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp)** · ★ 17.1k<br>Xiaohongshu MCP: login, publish image and video notes, search, read notes and comments, like and save; runs locally or in Docker.<br><sub>Platforms: RedNote</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-11-10 · 🔌 MCP · Chinese · Apache-2.0</sub>

- **[Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach)** · ★ 112.1k<br>Agent Reach: one CLI that lets an agent search and read Xiaohongshu, X, Bilibili, YouTube, Reddit and more: posts, comments and subtitles, with fallback tools per platform. <a id="faq"></a>
## FAQ

### What are the best agent skills for social media?

This list has 353 hand-checked skill projects (data updated 2026-11-16). Start with [All-in-one](#group-pipeline) if you run the whole loop yourself; otherwise go straight to [Writing and content](#group-writing), [Publishing and automation](#group-publish) or [Topics, trends and analytics](#group-research). The [By platform](#by-platforms) index lists every project per platform.

### Which skills work for X, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn?

92 projects target X, 129 YouTube, 104 TikTok and 53 LinkedIn. 29 work on any platform; the most-starred are [humanizer](https://github.com/blader/humanizer), [TrendRadar](https://github.com/sansan0/TrendRadar) and [Humanizer-zh](https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh).

### What is a social media skill, and how is it different from an MCP server?

A skill is a capability pack for an AI agent: a folder built around a `SKILL.md` file, sometimes with scripts and templates. Once installed, the agent follows it for one job, such as writing a LinkedIn post in your voice or turning an article into a thread. An MCP server is a tool that lets the agent read from or post to a platform directly. They are often used together: the skill decides what to write, the MCP server publishes it. MCP servers are listed separately under [MCP servers and CLI tools](#group-mcp) and are not counted as skills.

### Is it safe to let an agent post for me? Can my account get banned?

There are two risks. Your account: automated posting usually logs in as you, and some tools store your cookies on disk, so check where your session is kept and whether it is sent to another server. Platform rules: every platform limits automation, and bulk posting or heavy engagement can get an account throttled or banned. The safe pattern is to let the agent draft and schedule, and click publish yourself.

### What about Chinese platforms like Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin and WeChat?

141 projects target Xiaohongshu, 87 Douyin and 100 WeChat Official Accounts. Most are documented in Chinese; the descriptions here are translated.

### Are these projects safe to install?

Every repo was checked by hand (README, folders and files) and scanned by a script for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files. 353 skill projects and 51 tools and platforms made the list. Repos that were reviewed and turned down are recorded with the reason in [data/ignore.toml](data/ignore.toml) (in Chinese; 344 so far). A normal skill is a few text files and never needs an .exe or .dmg. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe, so read its `SKILL.md` and scripts before installing.

### How often is the list updated?

Every Monday, stars, last-updated dates and licenses refresh automatically and new repos are searched; new repos are added only after a manual check. See [New this week](#new).

## Resources

- [awesome-seo-geo-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-seo-geo-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): SEO and GEO skills that help search engines and AI answers find your content
- [awesome-short-drama-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): AI short-drama and manju skills, from scripts to storyboards and video prompts
- [awesome-story-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-story-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): open-source methods for getting LLMs to tell stories, also useful for voice-over scripts and story-driven copy
- [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): the official Agent Skills repo with the spec and examples, a good starting point for writing your own skill
- [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills): the `npx skills` installer, with the [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) directory

## Contributing

Suggest a project by [opening an issue](../../issues/new?template=submit-skill.yml), or edit `data/skills.toml` and open a PR; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (in Chinese; English issues and PRs are welcome). Your own social media skill is welcome too.
